overlaps.title: User site permissions are designed twice
overlaps.detail: 🖥 用户厂区权限 holds the page and all edit/view dialogs. Sentri Console（Done） › Access Control CN/EN copies the edit dialogs as 1440×960 overlays (编辑权限 - …) and one frame says it was moved over unchanged (8442:111920).
overlaps.call: Treat 🖥 用户厂区权限 as the source; Console copies follow it.

overlaps.title: Site layout file is an emptied copy
overlaps.detail: 🖥 场区布局 has two empty 场区布局 shells whose node ids are 物资消杀's 设备管理列表 / 门禁设备列表. The real site-layout design is in 🖥️ Console 初始化 (场区布局 page, 12 frames).
overlaps.call: Use Console 初始化 for site layout. The 场区布局 file has nothing to index yet.

overlaps.title: Sampling video viewer appears in two files
overlaps.detail: 查看采样视频 is in 🖥 采样与检测 (6001:6162) and again in 🖥 用户厂区权限 (2010:5621, plus three video-card states), where it opens from a permission's test report.
overlaps.call: Same viewer reached from two places; keep one design.

overlaps.title: Add pigs is designed twice
overlaps.detail: 🖥️ 猪舍、猪只 › 添加猪只 (file upload, confirm with/without errors, skip) and 🖥️ Console 初始化 › 添加猪只 (setup step, 1 frame + image).
overlaps.call: Setup step should reuse the 猪只 import flow; check which is newer.

overlaps.title: Add staff is designed twice
overlaps.detail: 🖥️ Console 初始化 › 添加员工 (bulk upload, confirm) and Sentri Console（Done） › Staff › Add User.
overlaps.call: Setup uses bulk import, Console adds one user; confirm both are wanted.

overlaps.title: Production line in three places
overlaps.detail: 🖥️ Console 初始化 › 创建生产线 (with KPI templates), 🖥️ 猪舍、猪只 › 生产线 (1 page), and the empty [Web] 生产线 file.
overlaps.call: The [Web] 生产线 file is the intended home; nothing is drawn there yet.

overlaps.title: Medicine management sits in the Immunization file
overlaps.detail: 药品管理 (list, add, delete) is drawn in 🖥 📱 免疫 under the heading '药品管理（还要改…）', but the Settings sidebar lists 药品管理.

overlaps.title: Health triage on the workbench and on pig detail
overlaps.detail: 工作台 › 健康分诊 drawers and 猪只详情 › 健康分诊等级 dialog (1257:4300) both set or show triage level.

overlaps.title: Workbench task drawers mirror the mobile production tasks
overlaps.detail: 工作台 › 生产-今日进度 has one drawer per task (查情, 配种, 返情检查, 孕检, 分娩, 产后母猪检查, 仔猪处理, 断奶检查, 结束保育检查, 结束育肥检查, 转舍): the same tasks as the app's features heat-check, breeding, return-heat, pregnancy, farrowing, post-farrowing, piglet-processing, weaning, end-nursery, end-finishing, move.
overlaps.call: Web shows progress; the phone does the work.
